_comment: CCV-L23's port tables of ooe_decrx_keep: the parent ooe_decrx's per-warp slot table read a stage early (OA 509 (3c), Option A), signed by OA in the register (OA 516).

sv_cq02h.why: ooe_decrx's per-warp slot table (OA 509 (3c), Option A): the parent's cq02h registers, written at a release or an allocation for the next cycle (advances bypassed through adv/adn), read by u_keep's enqueue compare at 01; no uop of a warp released or allocated in a cycle arrives in it (keep_row_settled; control row-early).
